dedupe_keys.name: eea ecosystem types of europe map

description: Ecosystem types of Europe is the European Environment Agency's wall-to-wall map of terrestrial and marine ecosystem types, linked to the Mapping and Assessment of Ecosystems and their Services (MAES) work. It covers the EEA-38 countries and the United Kingdom, combining the Copernicus land monitoring portfolio with marine bathymetry and translating land cover into the EUNIS habitat classification, with a separate reliability map showing how confident each assignment is. It is published by the EEA as dataset DAT-146, first published on 26 February 2019 and last modified on 9 October 2025, and described in the EEA briefing 19/2018 on mapping Europe's ecosystems. The 2012 version 3 revision 1 is available for download as GeoTIFF rasters (terrestrial, marine, full map and reliability map) and through OGC WMS and ESRI REST map services; the older 2006 version 2.1 is marked as superseded. The data page read today does not state a licence; downloads are free. Caveats: the reference year is 2012, and ecosystem classes are modelled from land cover, not surveyed. It serves as a baseline layer of natural and semi-natural green-blue infrastructure for ecosystem service, nature-based solution siting and climate adaptation studies across Europe; a related record is the CLMS high resolution tree cover and forests layer.
